title: Akbar Hun Tay Aja Vatana Tay, Ro Vain Karay Sughra
body:
Jay Jaan Di Akbar, Haye Tu Nay Aunha
Jay Jaan Di Akbar, Tenu Jaan Kaday Nah Dehndi
Dhak Laindi Tera Raah.
<<DIVIDER>>
Daswein Di Deegar Vi, Lag Gaye Shaama Payaan
Akbar Teray Auhn Diyaan,hun Tanga Muk Gayaan
Teray Vichran Daa Dukh Veera,
Jundiya Maar Gaya.
<<DIVIDER>>
Nanay Day Rozay Tay, Ja Ja Kay Rondi Ray
Teray Rawan Tay Veera, Din Raat Khalondi Ray
Hun Aan Kay Meh Dukhiyaa Di,
Ujri Johk Vasah.
<<DIVIDER>>
Lagda Eh Phupiyaan Vi, Beemar Nu Bhul Gayaan
Veraan Gharan Vich May, Dukhiyaari Rul Gayaan
May Jee Naye Sakhdi Kaliyaan,
Ho Gaye Veer Juda.
<<DIVIDER>>
May Suniya Junjh Teri, Val Shaam Day Jaani Ay
Kubra Tay Sakina Nay, Tenu Mehndi Launi Ay
Rab Janay Hun Kad Millsan,
Vichray Bhen Bhira.
<<DIVIDER>>
Barchi Nay Akbar Dah, Keeta Zakhmi Seena Ay
Sughra Beemar Paye, Barbaad Medina Ay
Akhtar Mu Pitkay Rohndi,
Bakiyeh Vich Zahra.
